definitions.explanation: Describes a person or animal that naturally warms up to people and is easy to get along with. Implies an endearing, open quality.

examples.japanese: {人懐|ひとなつ}っこい{笑顔|えがお}だ。
あの{犬|いぬ}は{人懐|ひとなつ}っこくて、{誰|だれ}にでも{尻尾|しっぽ}を{振|ふ}る。
examples.english: That dog is so friendly that it wags its tail at everyone.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{人懐|ひとなつ}っこい{性格|せいかく}で、{初対面|しょたいめん}の{人|ひと}ともすぐに{仲良|なかよ}くなる。
examples.english: She has such a sociable personality that she quickly becomes friends with people she meets for the first time.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{人|ひと} (person) + {懐|なつ}く (to become attached to) + っこい (adjective suffix indicating tendency). Literally describes someone who tends to warm up to people.

USAGE:
Always positive. Used for both people and animals, especially pets. Common collocations include {人懐|ひとなつ}っこい{笑顔|えがお} (a warm smile) and {人懐|ひとなつ}っこい{性格|せいかく} (a friendly personality).
